name: Tsuwano (Japan)
description: A white field with two thin red horizontal stripes near the top, charged at the centre with the Tsuwano town emblem: a black angular bracket-like device enclosing a comma-shaped swirl.
history: Municipal flag of Tsuwano, a town in Shimane Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 25 September 2005.
